title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2611.25184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empirical finance research often reuses natural experiments to study other outcomes, raising concerns about multiple testing and publication bias. We use AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 papers that reuse 13 natural experiments. The agents rebuild the data, reproduce each paper's main estimate and re-estimate it across grids totaling 62,409 estimated defensible specifications. Based on the reproductions and the specification grids, we develop measures of empirical robustness. We reproduce 42% of the main estimates of claims with a signed effect under the papers' own specifications. Across all defensible specifications, on average 25% keep the published sign and have $p < 0.10$. Across experiments, claims based on regression discontinuity are more robust than difference-in-differences claims. translated_title: 基于人工智能的实证金融研究多元宇宙分析：来自复用自然实验的证据
translated_abstract: 实证金融研究经常复用自然实验来研究其他结果变量，这引发了对多重检验和发表偏倚的担忧。我们利用AI智能体对复用13个自然实验的324篇论文开展多元宇宙分析。这些智能体重建数据、复现每篇论文的主要估计结果，并在总计62,409个可辩护设定组成的网格中重新进行估计。基于复现结果和设定网格，我们构建了实证稳健性的度量指标。在论文自身设定下，我们复现了带符号效应结论中42%的主要估计。在全部可辩护设定中，平均仅有25%的设定保持已发表的效应符号且p < 0.10。跨实验来看，基于断点回归的结论比双重差分结论更为稳健。在实验内部，关于一阶效应的结论、已发表t统计量较大的结论以及作者公开数据或代码的结论……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究利用AI智能体对324篇复用自然实验的实证金融论文进行多元宇宙分析，在62,409个可辩护设定中重新估计结果，发现仅42%的主要估计可复现、平均仅25%的设定保持已发表符号且p<0.10，并据此提出实证稳健性度量，显示断点回归类结论比双重差分更稳健。
en_tdlr: Using AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 empirical finance papers reusing 13 natural experiments across 62,409 defensible specifications, the study finds only 42% of main estimates reproduce and on average 25% retain published signs with p<0.10, developing empirical robustness measures and showing regression discontinuity claims are more robust than difference-in-differences claims.
